data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'ja'a' which means 'to be born, to come forth'. Jaisha means gentle, fragile, or delicate. It is a beautiful name for a girl in Islamic culture. The name Jaisha carries the meaning “Gentle, Fragile” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Jaisha usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle, fragile and live with faith, good character and purpose.
